description: Buy leads. THIS SPENDS MONEY AND CANNOT BE UNDONE. max_price_usd is required: nothing is bought if the price is higher. Paid from the account's credits (API key needed) it returns the leads at once: the first 25 inline and download links for the full set. Otherwise it returns a checkout link and an order id; a person pays on that page, then get_order returns the leads. Run quote_leads first.

after_id.description: Continue after this lead id (use next_after_id from an earlier order to get new leads).

email.description: Email for the receipt and for recovering the order.

filters.description: Search filters, all optional. Combine as needed; more filters means fewer leads.

category.description: Specific category, e.g. "Roofing contractor" (find names with list_industries and its search argument).

city.description: Exact city name (case-insensitive). Use together with state.

has_cell.description: Only leads that have a mobile phone number.

has_email.description: Only leads that have an email address.

has_facebook.description: Only leads that have a Facebook page.

has_owner_name.description: Only leads that have the owner's name.

has_phone.description: Only leads that have any phone number.

has_website.description: Only leads that have a website.

industry.description: Exact industry name from list_industries, e.g. "Construction & Contractors".

state.description: 2-letter US state code, or a comma-separated list such as "TX,OK".

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code, or a comma-separated list of ZIP codes.

fresh.description: Skip leads this account already received for the same search (default true when an API key is used).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Send the same value when retrying after a timeout so you are never charged twice for one purchase.

max_price_usd.description: REQUIRED spending cap in US dollars. Nothing is bought if the price is higher.

payment_method.description: auto (default): account credits when enough, else a Shared Payment Token if given, else a checkout link. checkout: always return a link for a person to pay.

quantity.description: How many leads (1 to 25,000). If fewer match, you get what matches.

shared_payment_token.description: Stripe Shared Payment Token (spt_...), only with payment_method "stripe_spt".

name: buy_leads

checkout_url.description: Open this page to pay (a person must do it).

leads.description: At most 25 leads, only when fulfilled. Use the download links for the full set.

leads_total.description: How many leads the order holds.

leads_truncated.description: True when more leads exist than the 25 shown inline.

next_step.description: What to do next, in plain words.

notes.description: Plain sentences from the API about this order, for example that the same search already has an unpaid order.

order_id.description: The order id. Keep it secret.

status.description: awaiting_payment, paid, fulfilled, expired, canceled, refunded or failed.

url_elicitation.description: Whether the checkout link was also offered through URL-mode elicitation.

title: Buy leads
